scope: independent root audit of the actual collision-polynomial identities, spacing constants, Selberg pair-sieve aggregation, capacity interpretation, replay, and canonical promotion

checks.root_repairs: Repaired TeX operator spacing and two embedded carriage-return corruptions, then repinned the Item 384 dependency and all Item 391 artifacts to their canonical paths. No mathematical statement or constant changed.

mathematical_audit.actual_family: F_M is formed from the actual Item 363 joint-gate prime set, so every resultant and endpoint radical identity is an exact reformulation of that set rather than an ambient selector claim.
mathematical_audit.resultant: For monic squarefree F_M, Res(F_M(X),F_M(X+2d)) is the product over roots p,q of p+2d-q and vanishes exactly when two actual collision primes differ by 2d.
mathematical_audit.endpoint_radicals: Under the stated tied-interval inequalities, p divides q minus or plus 2d only for the corresponding adjacent endpoint; squarefreeness of R_M then gives the two exact gcd radicals.
mathematical_audit.spacing_constant: The candidate interval has numerical length (M-9)/6. Exclusion through row offset D forces numerical gaps greater than 2D, hence N_M <= 1+floor((M-9)/(12D)) and normalized ceiling 1/(72c) when D is asymptotic to c log M.
mathematical_audit.converse: W/(6M)>=rho implies N_M>=6 rho M/log U_M; pigeonhole in the same interval then forces a vanishing offset d <= (1+o(1))log(U_M)/(72 rho).
mathematical_audit.sieve: The classical uniform Selberg upper-bound sieve for d<=log X, combined with the exact divisor expansion and Wallis bound sum_{d<=D} S(d)<2D, gives clustered endpoint mass O(DM/log M), hence o(M) for D=o(log M).
mathematical_audit.capacity: The unconditional theorem closes only fixed and sublogarithmic cluster carriers. It supplies neither logarithmic-scale nonvanishing nor a strict whole-cell upper bound, so the fixed-j=1 ceiling remains 1/36 and the Route 1 ledger does not move.
